changed.title: The mixed fraction and Gaussian fluctuations of the largest extension at the singular mixing threshold
changed.statement:
∀ T D : ℕ → ℕ, Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
  (∀ k, 2 ≤ D k) →
  ∀ x : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => 6*(T k : ℝ)/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^(D k))
    - 2*Real.log ((2 : ℝ)^(D k))) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
  ∀ z : Option ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ =>
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let t := T k
  let d := D k
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let a := 3*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>
    if i.val % 2 = b.val / 2 ∧ (i.val / 2 % 3 = b.val % 2 ∨ i.val / 2 % 3 = 2)
    then (1:F) else 0
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin 4, (∑ i, h i b * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i)
  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)
  let spaces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter good
  let layer := spaces.filter (fun U : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F U = d)
  let mixed := layer.filter (fun U => ∀ b : Fin 2, ∃ i ∈ supp U, i.val % 2 = b.val)
  let s := (2 : ℝ)^d
  let mu := (n : ℝ)/(1+Real.sqrt (s-1))
  let host := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (spaces.filter (fun E : Submodule F W => U ≤ E)).sup (fun E => Module.finrank F E)
  let event : Finset (Submodule F W) := match z with
    | none => mixed
    | some y => mixed.filter (fun U =>
        (2*((a-host U : ℕ) : ℝ)-mu)/Real.sqrt mu ≤ y)
  (event.card : ℝ)/(layer.card : ℝ)) Filter.atTop
    (nhds ((Real.exp x/(2+Real.exp x)) * (match z with
      | none => 1
      | some y => ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) (Set.Iic y)).toReal)))

changed.title: Quadratic parity obstructions through affine nullity six and a fixed cubic correction
changed.statement:
∀ k : ℕ,
  let F := ZMod 2
  let S := Fin k → F
  let quad := fun (f : S → F) => ∃ (b : F) (l : S) (M : Fin k → Fin k → F),
    ∀ s, f s = b + dotProduct l s + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * s i * s j
  ∀ (E : Finset S) (a : S), a ∈ E →
    let W := Submodule.span F (Set.image (fun s : S => s-a) (↑E : Set S))
    let rel := fun (U : Finset S) => U ⊆ E ∧ ∀ f : S → F, quad f → (∑ s ∈ U, f s) = 0
    let cube := fun (U : Finset S) =>
      ∃ (b : S) (L : (Fin 3 → F) →ₗ[F] S), Function.Injective L ∧
        ∀ s : S, s ∈ U ↔ ∃ x : Fin 3 → F, s = b+L x
    let twelve := fun (U : Finset S) =>
      ∃ (b : S) (L : (Fin 5 → F) →ₗ[F] S), Function.Injective L ∧
        ∀ s : S, s ∈ U ↔ ∃ x : Fin 5 → F, x 0*x 1+x 2*x 3 = 1 ∧ s = b+L x
    (E.card ≤ Module.finrank F W + 7 →
      (∀ U : Finset S, U ⊆ E → U.Nonempty → (rel U ↔ cube U ∨ twelve U)) ∧
      ∀ U V : Finset S, rel U → rel V → U.Nonempty → V.Nonempty → U = V) ∧
    (∀ h : S → F, (∃ f : S → F, quad f ∧ ∀ s ∈ E, h s = f s) ↔
      ∀ U : Finset S, rel U → (∑ s ∈ U, h s) = 0) ∧
    ∀ O : Finset S, rel O → O.Nonempty →
      (∀ U : Finset S, rel U → U.Nonempty → U = O) →
      ∃ i j l : Fin k, (∑ s ∈ O, s i*s j*s l) = 1 ∧
        ∀ h : S → F, ∃ f : S → F, quad f ∧
          ∀ s ∈ E, h s = f s + (∑ u ∈ O, h u) * s i*s j*s l

changed.context: On a relation U the affine evaluations are self-orthogonal, since their products are quadratic. Their rank bounds the size by twelve. let F := fun n : ℕ => Finset ((Fin n × Bool) × (Fin n × Bool))
let sat := fun (n : ℕ) (A : F n) (x : W n) =>
  ∀ c ∈ A, x c.1.1 ≠ c.1.2 ∨ x c.2.1 ≠ c.2.2
let delta := fun (n : ℕ) (r z : W n) =>
  Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => z i ≠ r i)
let free := fun (n : ℕ) (r : W n) (S : Finset (W n)) =>
  ∀ D : Finset (W n), D ⊆ S → ∃ A : F n, ∀ x : W n,
    (sat n A x ↔ (x = r ∨ x ∈ D))
∀ (n : ℕ) (r : W n),
  (∃ S : Finset (W n), r ∉ S ∧ free n r S ∧ S.card = n + n / 2) ∧
  ∀ S : Finset (W n), r ∉ S → free n r S →
    S.card ≤ n + n / 2 ∧
    (S.card = n + n / 2 ↔
      ∃ P : Finset (Finset (Fin n)), P.card = n / 2 ∧
        (∀ e ∈ P, e.card = 2) ∧
        (∀ e ∈ P, ∀ f ∈ P, e ≠ f → Disjoint e f) ∧
        ∀ z : W n, (z ∈ S ↔ ((delta n r z).card = 1 ∨ delta n r z ∈ P)))

changed.statement:

changed.title: Counting distinct functions fitting two-sparse examples with one binary AND/OR gate and free parity recovers the number of three-colorings
changed.statement:
∀ k : ℕ,
  let K := Fin k
  let p := k.choose 2
  let n := 2+2*k+2*p
  let h := 4+3*k+6*p
  let V := Fin n → Bool
  let colors := K → Fin 3
  let edges := fun (g : K → K → Bool) => (Finset.univ : Finset (K × K)).filter
    (fun e => e.1 < e.2 ∧ g e.1 e.2 = true)
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let fits := fun (C : Circ) => PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack n C ∧
    (∀ u ∈ C.gates, u.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
      (u.op = .and ∨ u.op = .or ∨ u.op = .mod 2 ∨ (u.op = .not ∧ u.inputs.length = 1))) ∧
    C.gates.countP (fun u => @decide
      ((u.op = .and ∨ u.op = .or) ∧ u.inputs.length = 2) (Classical.propDecidable _)) ≤ 1
  let rep := fun (f : V → Bool) => ∃ C : Circ, fits C ∧ ∀ x : V, f x = C.eval (List.ofFn x)
  ∃ (X : Fin h → V) (S : Finset (Fin h)) (base : Fin h → Bool)
    (ask : Fin h → Option (K × K)) (decode : (V → Bool) → colors),
    Function.Injective X ∧ S.card = p ∧
    (∀ t, ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i => X t i)).card ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ S, ask t = none ∧ base t = false) ∧
    (∀ t i j, ask t = some (i,j) → t ∉ S ∧ i < j) ∧
    (∀ i j : K, i < j → ∃! t, ask t = some (i,j)) ∧
    ∀ g : K → K → Bool,
      let m := (edges g).card
      let d := fun (c : colors) => ((edges g).filter (fun e => c e.1 = c e.2)).card
      let label := fun t => (ask t).elim (base t) (fun ij => g ij.1 ij.2)
      let err := fun (f : V → Bool) => ∑ t : Fin h,
        if f (X t) = label t then 0 else if t ∈ S then 1 else p+1
      (∀ (c : colors) (q : ℕ), q ≤ p →
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (V → Bool)).filter (fun f => @decide
          (rep f ∧ decode f = c ∧ err f = q) (Classical.propDecidable _))).card =
          if d c ≤ q then 2^(k+(p-m)+d c) * (m-d c).choose (q-d c) else 0) ∧
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (V → Bool)).filter (fun f => @decide
        (rep f ∧ ∀ t, f (X t) = label t) (Classical.propDecidable _))).card =
        2^(k+(p-m)) * ((Finset.univ : Finset colors).filter (fun c => d c = 0)).card

changed.title: The scheduled common-key rule propagates mixed endpoint observations with an arbitrary set of erased driving bits
changed.statement:
∀ (k r h : ℕ), k % 2 = 1 →
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let first := fun (rowKey rowName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun rowState rowIndex =>
      step (rowState ^^^ rot 1 rowState ^^^ rot (k - 1) rowState) ^^^
        rot (2 * rowIndex) rowKey ^^^ constant (rowIndex + 1)) (rot 1 rowKey ^^^ rowName)
  let second := fun (colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun colState colIndex =>
      step (colState ^^^ rot 2 colState ^^^ rot (k - 2) colState) ^^^
        rot (3 * (colIndex + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (r + (colIndex + 1)))
      (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let V := Fin 5 × Fin k
  let word := fun (v : V → Bool) (track : Fin 5) =>
    ∑ j : Fin k, (v (track,j)).toNat * 2^j.val
  let agrees := fun (v : V → Bool) =>
    word v 3 = first (word v 2) (word v 0) ∧
    word v 4 = second (word v 2) (word v 1)
  let branch := if k % 3 = 0 then 4^r else 1
  let rounds := 512*((r+1)*(Nat.clog 2 (k+1)+1)+h+1)
  ∃ (m : ℕ) (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Sum V (Fin m)))),
    m + (∑ C ∈ F, C.card) ≤ 16777216*(k+1)*(r+1)*branch*(h+1)^2*(Nat.clog 2 (3*k+1)+1)*2^h ∧
    (∀ C ∈ F, C.card ≤ 3) ∧
    (∀ v : V → Bool, agrees v ↔ ∃ aux : Fin m → Bool,
      PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfies (Sum.elim v aux) (↑F : Set _)) ∧
    ∀ (rowRev colRev : Bool) (ρ : V → Option Bool),
      let driver := fun j : V => j.1 = 2 ∨
        j.1 = (if rowRev then 3 else 0) ∨ j.1 = (if colRev then 4 else 1)
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : V => driver j ∧ ρ j = none)).card ≤ h →
      let seed : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Literal (Sum V (Fin m))) :=
        {l | ∃ raw : V, l.1 = Sum.inl raw ∧ ρ raw = some l.2}
      let advance := fun S : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Literal (Sum V (Fin m))) =>
        S ∪ {l | ∃ C ∈ F, l ∈ C ∧ ∀ other ∈ C, other ≠ l →
          PEqualNP.Search.negLit other ∈ S}
      let known := (advance^[rounds]) seed
      let complete := fun v : V → Bool => agrees v ∧
        ∀ (raw : V) (sign : Bool), ρ raw = some sign → v raw = sign
      ((¬ ∃ v, complete v) ↔ ∃ C ∈ F, ∀ l ∈ C, PEqualNP.Search.negLit l ∈ known) ∧
      ((∃ v, complete v) → ∀ raw : V, ∀ sign : Bool,
        (∀ v, complete v → v raw = sign) ↔ (Sum.inl raw, sign) ∈ known)
